category.name: Workflow automation
category.description: Connect business apps and automate multi-step processes with triggers, actions and orchestration.
category.audience: Business operations, sales, marketing, IT and other teams connecting everyday applications.
category.audienceRationale: Cross-department workflow integration; relevant across industries, but requires processes that benefit from automation.

pricing.note: Professional advertised from USD19.99/month; yearly toggle, usage tiers apply. Free plan is 100 tasks and two-step Zaps.
Usage credits verified; plan-price widget absent from retrieved page. Entry amount and billing basis need verification; monthly is provisional.

oss.name: Node-RED
oss.classificationReason: Node-RED editor/runtime are Apache-2.0, self-hostable and commercially hostable. No paid core edition identified in official product documentation. FlowFuse hosting and enterprise fleet management are a separate platform, outside this record. Third-party nodes have independent licenses.

health.rsx: Central rsx quick analysis available; overall 7.6/10. Signals only, not license proof.

oss.name: Activepieces
locked: Commercial cloud/on-prem plans gate projects, shared global connections, Git releases and governance; exact boundaries of MIT Community Edition still need confirmation.
oss.classificationReason: Core outside packages/ee and server API ee paths is MIT; enterprise paths use a different license. Official installation distinguishes Community from EE; current pricing combines cloud/on-prem paid plans without an unambiguous MIT Community matrix. Do not impose hosted credit/BYO-key limits on MIT source without verification. Commercial use/hosting of MIT core permitted; enterprise embedding requires separate terms.

health.rsx: Central rsx quick analysis available; overall 5.7/10. Signals only, not license proof.

oss.name: Windmill (OSS source build)
locked: Kafka/NATS/SQS/cloud-event triggers and SQL Server/Oracle runtimes paid.
Content search, workspace error handlers, some Git/deployment features and enterprise governance paid.
Published free edition has workspace/user/group quotas; vendor Community Docker/release binaries include proprietary code with resale, hosting and modification restrictions.
oss.classificationReason: Non-enterprise source build is AGPLv3 with Apache client/spec components; proprietary snippets excluded. Commercial hosting of AGPL build is possible subject to AGPL. Vendor Community binaries are separately restricted, not the OSS artifact identified here. Workflow features are paid, so C.

health.rsx: Central rsx quick analysis available; overall 6.5/10. Signals only, not license proof.
